newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilgener to bid for Colombia power plants.
newsitem.headline: Chilgener to bid for Colombia power plants.

text.p: Chilean electricity utility Chilgener SA said it is planning to bid in the privatization of two large power plants in Colombia which are expected to be sold this year.

Chilgener will link up with Colombian finance group Sarmiento and other partners to bid for the 1,000 megawatt (MW) Chivor and 500 MW Betania hydro-electric projects, general manager Juan Antonio Guzman told a news conference.
Another Chilean power firm, electricity giant Endesa, has already said it plans to bid for these plants.
Another project on Chilgener's drawing board is the construction of a combined-cycle power plant near Bogota but this will depend on reaching a deal to secure natural gas supplies, he said.
"The combined-cycle project has no deadline as it basically depends on striking a deal with the owner of the gas field," said Guzman.
Chilgener, which already has heavy investments in Argentina, is also planning to move into Brazil with projects including building a $600 million power plant in the state of Parana.
